habituation_index.description: Quantifies the attenuation of orienting or motor response across repeated cue presentations within a session without positive reinforcement.
habituation_index.interpretation: Values > 0.60 indicate rapid sensory habituation, requiring variable reinforcement schedules.

acoustic_discrimination_ratio.description: Measures whether the dog distinguishes the canine-inspired cue from acoustically matched control sounds (pure tones or spectrally shaped noise).
acoustic_discrimination_ratio.interpretation: Values > 0.50 confirm cue-specific discrimination above general auditory arousal.

response_latency_median_ms.description: Median time in milliseconds from acoustic cue onset to unequivocal motor orientation toward speaker or owner.

intention_congruence_rate.description: Percentage of trials where the dog executes the target intention (e.g. recall approach, sit/stay, play bow) without supplementary human gestures.

association_retention_rate.description: Retention ratio of learned cue-to-action association after a 7-day non-exposure retention interval.

freezing_quiescence_rate.description: Percentage of presentations resulting in immobility or inhibition; critical safety metric distinguishing genuine calmness from behavioral inhibition or fear.
freezing_quiescence_rate.interpretation: Any trial with FQR > 5% triggers immediate veterinary review and volume attenuation.
